sum_insured_options: Rs. 50,000; Rs. 1 Lakh; Rs. 2 Lakhs; Rs. 3 Lakhs; Rs. 5 Lakhs; Rs. 7.5 Lakhs; Rs. 10 Lakhs; Rs. 15 Lakhs; Rs. 20 Lakhs; Rs. 25 Lakhs

room_rent.note: Room rent capped at Rs.2,000/day for SI of Rs.50,000, Rs.1L and Rs.2L. No room rent limit for SI above Rs.2 Lakhs.

icu.note: No separate ICU sub-limit mentioned; covered under inpatient hospitalisation expenses at actuals.

copayment.note: 20% co-payment applies only when insured is rated/premium paid for Tier 2 location but treatment taken in a Tier 1 location hospital. Not applicable on Daily Care Benefit, Compassionate Travel, Repatriation of Mortal Remains, and Medical Second Opinion.

sub_limits.display: Ambulance capped; Recharge benefit capped by SI slab
sub_limits.note: Ambulance capped at 1% of SI max Rs.2,000/hospitalisation. Recharge benefit for related claims has defined limits per SI slab (e.g. Rs.75,000 for 3L SI). Additional RTA SI capped at 25% of SI max Rs.3L. New Born Baby cover capped at 10% of SI max Rs.50,000. No disease-wise sub-limits on main inpatient cover for SI above Rs.2L.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Applies to listed conditions including cataract, hernia, BPH, varicose veins, joint replacement, stones, etc. Does not apply to accident claims.

maternity.note: Maternity is explicitly excluded (Code-Excl18). New Born Baby cover (inpatient from Day 1, up to 10% of SI max Rs.50,000) is available if mother covered for 12 continuous months.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% increase per claim-free year; maximum 50% of SI. Reduced by 10% in the event of a claim. Reduction does not reduce base SI.

restoration.note: 100% restoration of SI once per policy year for unrelated illness/injury claims only, triggered on exhaustion or insufficiency of SI and cumulative bonus. Not available for RTA claims, pre/post-hosp, or additional covers. Separate Recharge Benefit (once/yr, defined limits) available for related claims.

domiciliary.note: Covered if patient cannot be moved to hospital or no hospital bed available; condition must continue at least 3 days. Certain ailments excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, etc.). Cashless not available.

ayush.note: Covers inpatient and day-care AYUSH treatment (Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy) in recognised AYUSH hospitals/day care centres.

organ_donor.note: Covers harvesting expenses of legal organ donor. Donor's pre/post-hosp and other treatment not covered.

ambulance.note: 1% of SI subject to maximum Rs.2,000 per hospitalisation.

modern_treatments.note: Day care list includes robotic/laparoscopic and advanced procedures; no explicit modern treatment sub-limit stated.

consumables.display: Not covered (base); Optional via Home Care add-on
consumables.note: Non-medical consumables explicitly excluded (Annexure 2). Home Care Treatment add-on covers a defined list of consumables for home care treatment.

notable_exclusions: Maternity, STDs, hearing aids/eyeglasses, dental (unless GA+hospitalisation), external congenital anomalies, impotence treatment, non-medical consumables (Annexure 2)
optional_riders: Medical Second Opinion (WLMC), Flexi OP Care (OPD consultations/diagnostics, 4 plans), Home Care Treatment (daily limit Rs.1,000–10,000, listed conditions)
insurer: Cholamandalam MS General Insurance Company Limited
